description.text: Courses (compulsory ) •Chinese phonetics and teaching •Chinese vocabulary and teaching •Chinese grammar and teaching •Chinese characters and teaching •Chinese as a second language teaching theory •Introduction to linguistics •Introduction to Chinese culture •Modern and contemporary literature •Ancient literature •Tourism geography •Chinese design and application of multimedia courseware •Educational psychology •Teacher 's spoken language Elective courses: •Folk music •Calligraphy and practice •Martial arts and practice •Chinese errors analysis for foreign students •Intercultural communication •China's national conditions •Speech and recitation •Methods to teaching Chinese as a second language •Literature retrieval and essay writing •Class teaching methods and techniques •Chinese information processing

duration.text: The Teaching Chinese as a Second Language at Nanjing Normal University is a 4 Years long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 2305 USD/per year ￥ 16600 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1. Certificate of HSK Certificate of HSK(Chinese Proficiency Test) 2. Photocopy of valid passport With name, passport number & expiration date, and photo included 3. Passport photo A recent passport-sized photo of the applicant 4. Certificate/diploma of highest education Graduation certificate in languages other than Chinese or English should be translated into Chinese or English and be certified by notarization. 5. Academic transcript of highest education

requirements.text: 1.Age of 18 or above 2.Healthy foreigner 3.A high school graduate or with equivalent qualification 4.Pass Band 6 of the HSK Examination
